readme.title: README
readme.content:
Quartz v5

“[One] who works with the door open gets all kinds of interruptions, but [they] also occasionally gets clues as to what the world is and what might be important.” — Richard Hamming

Quartz is a set of tools that helps you publish your digital garden and notes as a website for free.
🔗 Read the documentation and get started: quartz.jzhao.xyz/

sources/sources_registry.title: Sources_Registry
sources/sources_registry.content:
Sources Registry
This registry maps the archival sources for the Hong Kong History Research Project.
Category 1: Official Archives and Digital Libraries

UK National Archives - Colonial Office Original Correspondence (CO 129 Series): discovery.nationalarchives.gov.uk/browse/r/h/C4367
Hong Kong Public Records Office (Government Records Service): www.grs.gov.hk/ws/english/org_pro.htm
Hong Kong Memory Project (HKM): www.hkmemory.hk/en/index.html
Hong Kong Public Libraries Multimedia Information System (MMIS): mmis.hkpl.gov.hk/
Legislative Council Archives (LegCo Archives): www.legco.gov.hk/general/english/sec/lc_archives/lc_archives.htm
HKU Digital Initiatives (University of Hong Kong Libraries): digitalrepository.lib.hku.hk/
HSBC Group Archives (Hong Kong Collection): www.hsbc.com/who-we-are/our-history/history-website
Catholic Diocese of Hong Kong Archives: archives.catholic.org.hk/
Tung Wah Group of Hospitals Heritage Museum & Archives: www.tungwah.org.hk/en/heritage/heritage-landing/

Category 2: Academic and Specialist Blogs and Portals

Hong Kong History Centre (University of Bristol): www.hkhistory.net/feed/
Historical Photographs of Hong Kong (Bristol Platform): blog.hphkbristol.net/feed/
Gwulo: Old Hong Kong: gwulo.com/rss.xml
The Industrial History of Hong Kong Group: industrialhistoryhk.org/feed/
Hong Kong Heritage Project: www.hongkongheritage.org
Elizabeth Ride Archive (BAAG & WWII Records): www.elizabethridearchive.com/
Battle for Hong Kong (Wartime Research Blog): battleforhongkong.blogspot.com/feeds/posts/default
Royal Asiatic Society Hong Kong Branch (RASHK): royalasiaticsociety.org.hk/
